goodToKnow: Die Belastbarkeit is the ability to handle stress or load: hohe Belastbarkeit is a stock phrase in German job ads, meaning ability to work under pressure. Technically it's load capacity: die Belastbarkeit eines Materials. Belastbar also means reliable: belastbare Daten, belastbare Beweise. Die Last is load. It has no plural.
